## Course Strengths

### Teaching Methodology
Students consistently praise the hands-on approach, with recorded lectures providing flexibility for review and self-paced learning.

### Assessment Strategy
The balanced assessment approach reduces exam pressure while maintaining academic rigor through practical assignments.

### Course Content
Students appreciate the comprehensive coverage of operating systems concepts with modern, relevant examples.

## Share Your Feedback

We welcome feedback from all students to help us improve the course experience. Contact the instructor directly or use the anonymous feedback system for suggestions.
